name: Gaurang Mali
headline: Lead NetSuite Developer / Architect and Senior consultant
position: Lead NetSuite Developer / Architect and Senior Consultant
about:
I am an accomplished and results-driven professional with over 12 years of comprehensive experience in NetSuite ERP, possessing a strong technical, functional, scripting, and administrative background. My expertise lies in understanding complex business requirements, documenting technical workflows, and seamlessly translating them into tailored solutions. I specialize in NetSuite scripting, Advanced PDF templates, customizations, and integrations, consistently delivering quality work that meets or exceeds expectations.
Over the years, I have been fortunate to work across various industries, including U.S. taxation, solar energy, travel, product-based organizations, service providers, and the radio sector. My efforts have always been aligned with helping businesses achieve their goals, while consistently delivering high-quality, maintainable solutions within deadlines.

Key Skills and Expertise
NetSuite Customization & Development: Expertise in SuiteScript (Client, UserEvent, Restlet, Suitelet, Schedule, Plugin, Map Reduce, Workflow Action, and SuiteCommerce Advanced), with an emphasis on performance optimization and future-proofing code.
Business Process Proficiency: Extensive experience in NetSuite modules, including Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, GL, AR, AP, Fixed Assets, and Inventory Management, ensuring seamless operations from sales order creation to fulfillment, invoicing, and tax application.
Data Migration Expertise: Successfully migrated complex objects like Trial Balances, Customer Masters, and Open Invoices from TM1 and Agresso to NetSuite.
Technical Documentation & Client Engagement: Skilled in creating technical design documents, workflows, and use cases, and collaborating directly with clients to document pain points and create actionable plans.
Continuous Learning & Innovation: Recently mastered Mithril, a lightweight framework for single-page applications, and used it to develop advanced Suitelet-based tools and portals that overcame standard UI limitations.
Team Leadership & Project Management: Experienced in leading offshore teams, distributing work, resolving challenges, and balancing multiple projects to meet deadlines.
Tools & Methodologies: Proficient with Eclipse, JetBrains WebStorm, Jira, ServiceNow, GitHub, and Agile SDLC methodologies.

I am driven by a passion for innovation and excellence, with a proven track record of delivering impactful results. My dedication to continuous learning and adaptability ensures I bring value to every organization I work with
